scope: Every repository raster copied by the current public build, plus the twelve responsive derivatives. External runtime images and media retain their catalog/source attribution; this manifest does not verify those remote files.
evidencePolicy: User-supplied attribution is limited to the two confirmed source PNGs. Other historical rasters are recorded as inherited-unverified, even where older metadata exists. No author, license, rights, or generated/non-generated origin is inferred for those historical assets.

transformation.operation: Resize and encode retained originals; no generative image tool or artwork generation is involved.
transformation.validation: The build rejects empty outputs or outputs whose byte size is not smaller than their source PNG. This documentation does not independently certify a completed build or rendered visual output.
